shortDefinition: A Bureau field type for dynamic tables that support add/remove/reorder with nested fields.

children.text: REPEATABLE_GROUP handles arrays of structured data such as shareholders, officers, or jurisdictions. Each row can contain multiple nested fields and supports drag-and-drop reorder.
Supports min/max items, template defaults, and patch-based updates.
Works with computed fields (for example percentage totals) and JSONLogic visibility.
Backed by production component RepeatablePersonField.tsx (262 lines).

seo.title: REPEATABLE_GROUP Field Type
seo.description: Definition of REPEATABLE_GROUP, the Bureau field type for dynamic arrays.
